Topic 6.2: Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia
3. Practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 6.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA MAKALA YA KUJICHAGULIA
This lesson teaches Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia for Grade 5 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia above.
2. Explain Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia
3. Practise Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Makala ya kujichagulia at school and at home
